name: 47119 · Floyds Knobs, IN
findings: ZIP 47119 (Floyds Knobs) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47119 (Floyds Knobs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 47119 (Floyds Knobs) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
